definitions.relation_accuracy: share of the 6,000 relation items whose predicted relation equals the gold relation
definitions.group_accuracy: share of the 1,000 curated group items whose predicted class equals the gold class exactly (kind, k and chain); readings excluded
definitions.set_size: number of member outcomes in a group item
definitions.missing: relation: abstained items, scored as their recorded answer as in the published scores (an abstention is recorded as NONE); group: items with no answer, counted wrong (group abstentions are not recorded per item)
definitions.examples: the modal-confusion rule: for each op, the model's most frequent wrong (gold, predicted) cell, ties by class name; within it, the item the most other models answered correctly, ties by lowest qid; abstentions and items the v0.1.1 audit judged suspect_label or unclear are excluded

test-L01.name: Lunaria
test-L01.card:
Rules of the Lunaria League and Lunaria Cup. Teams: Belford, Karworth, Henworth, Falport, Karmoor, Henby.
Exactly 2 teams qualify for the playoffs; each qualifier has at least 2 points.
The Cup has exactly one winner and one runner-up, two different teams, both playoff qualifiers.
So the 2 qualifiers are exactly the Cup winner and the runner-up.
If Karworth wins the Cup, Henby is runner-up.
At least 1 team has 5 points or more.
At most 5 teams have 2 points or more.
For each t from 1 to 5: if Belford has at least t points, Falport has at least t + 1.
Karworth has at least as many points as Henworth.
The Cup winner has at least 4 points.
